title: A Candidate Exact Three-Item Independent-Cap Oracle
oneLine: A producer-side candidate exact oracle gives a rational three-item max-frequency relaxation-gap lower bound of 1.1487291464748206... and a verifier-checked route to instance-specific logistics stress tests.
abstract: This anonymous unrefereed successor candidate constructs an exact three-item independent-cap oracle for continuous-time common-origin fixed-interval joint replenishment. A finite primitive-triple enumeration and strict global tail candidate theorem support an exact rational bundled-instance ratio of 1.1487291464748205845..., 3.3132 percent above the producer-side unrefereed two-item upper endpoint. A monotonicity lemma propagates the candidate lower bound to every fixed item count of at least three. An exact five-policy family explains the witness, while sixteen exact vertex certificates prove two conservative inner boxes under simultaneous relative holding-cost perturbation only. The bundled five-policy sets are synthetic regression fixtures; every fitted logistics instance must regenerate and verifier-check its own candidate set across primitive and boundary regimes. The 14.8729 percent lower-bound optimism is not a savings claim. Independent rerun, reimplementation, formal verification, external specialist review, external editorial peer review, operational validation, and field impact are not assessed.
narration: What changes when joint replenishment moves from two items to three? This unrefereed candidate gives a precise answer for one rational, common-origin, fixed-interval model. The standard max-frequency relaxation has an exact lower value, while the best coordinated calendar uses primitive period multipliers three, three, and two. Their exact ratio is approximately 1.1487291465—above the producer-certified two-item endpoint. A candidate monotonicity argument propagates this lower bound to every fixed item count of at least three. The computation is finite and exact. It examines 49,981 primitive coordination patterns, checks all boundary regimes, and closes every omitted pattern with a strict tail inequality. Ordinary, optimized, and fresh-extraction replays each pass twenty-one tests. Two exhaustive portfolio documents freeze the five near-tied calendars only as synthetic regression fixtures, while sixteen vertex certificates establish two conservative inner holding-cost boxes. These figures are not operational savings. The 14.8729 percent headline difference measures optimism in one relaxation on a synthetic normalized instance. The strongest witness is exceptionally sensitive to its coefficients. No real orders, service levels, stockouts, labour, or implementation costs were measured. The logistics handoff is therefore staged. Use the oracle to stress-test three products that genuinely share an order, shipment, receiving session, or setup. Then validate event ownership and units, regenerate a verifier-checked instance-specific candidate set across primitive and boundary regimes, model joint uncertainty and omitted constraints, simulate service outcomes, and run shadow planning before any design-adequate field comparison with stop rules. The scholarly creator is Anonymous. Ian Pitchford directed the research and maintains the release. AI systems assisted under human direction. Producer-side replay and internal journal-like review are not independent verification, formal proof, field validation, or journal peer review.

keyResults: The lower bound is 3.3132 percent above the producer-side unrefereed two-item upper endpoint and propagates to every fixed item count n at least 3, subject to the candidate proof boundary.
The finite closure enumerates 49,981 primitive triples at minimal cutoff S=21 and proves a strict omitted-triple tail margin.
Sixteen exact vertex certificates prove two conservative simultaneous holding-cost inner boxes; the frozen five-policy sets are synthetic regression fixtures only.
The exact oracle is proposed as a logistics stress test and regression benchmark; no field saving or operational impact is claimed.
evidence: The versioned package contains the 16-page manuscript and Markdown source, three point certificates, sixteen holding-cost vertex certificates, two holding-box reports, exact portfolio reconstruction across 49,981 primitive triples and four boundary regimes per witness, a 61-file generated-artifact ledger, a 143-file package manifest, 21 deterministic tests with mutation and path-containment controls, ordinary and optimized replay, a final fresh-extraction replay, the complete internal five-role review record, response matrix, failed confirmation decision and bounded Editor closure. These are producer-side exact-computation, software and internal editorial records—not unaffiliated independent reproduction, formal verification, external peer review, operational validation or impact evidence.

Extend the executable oracle to directly accept arbitrary coupled resource rows while preserving exact assurance.
Measure the distribution of relaxation gaps in representative eligible logistics triplets and retain null or ineligible cases.
Run preregistered simulation, shadow and field evaluations with service stop rules, implementation costs and a defensible comparator before any savings or impact claim.

decisionObject.description: An exact rational three-item gap certificate, fixed-item monotonicity implication, exact holding-box comparison, verifier-checked instance-specific candidate-set builder, and staged decision rule for whether a logistics triplet warrants operational evaluation.
decisionObject.scope: Three-item stationary common-origin periodic policies with rational independent frequency caps; logistics use is diagnostic until omitted constraints and outcomes are evaluated separately.

semanticBridge.description: Common and item-specific model coefficients map to incremental replenishment-event, handling, and deterministic holding costs only after domain validation. The exact oracle maps to a triplet benchmark, not directly to executed orders.
remainingRisks: Frequency caps may be invalid proxies for pointwise transport or dock capacity.
Stochastic demand, lead times, service, order rounding, minimum quantities, and nonlinear tariffs are outside the certificate.
No representative company dataset or field comparison has been evaluated.

humanJudgmentGates: Confirm that the three items share an incremental common event and every coefficient has defensible operational semantics.
Keep exact synthetic lower-bound optimism separate from savings or field performance.
Require simulation and shadow evaluation before any order execution.
Require preregistered service stop rules and a defensible comparator before causal or net-value language.
Confirm Anonymous scholarly attribution, licences, immutable identifiers, and release authority before publication.
